rule: When several stories in one wave add Alembic migrations, the planner pins each one's down_revision in merge order, and the merger checks `alembic heads` shows one head after every merge.
why: Parallel coders each pointed down_revision at the head they saw, so the sprint branch had multiple heads and was re-linearised three times.
evidence: commit fc4e7a7 Linearize Alembic chain after merging wave 3
commit 5d88248 Linearise Alembic chain: s45 follows s42
commit 6566611 re-points s15, s19, s35, s41 down_revision

rule: A story whose plan edits files another story creates goes in a later wave than that story, never the same wave; the planner flags the edit and the wave plan honours it.
why: s39 planned edits to s15's plan_lines and runners but ran in the same wave and committed first, so it was left partial until a follow-up commit.
evidence: waves.json wave 5 holds s15 and s39
s39 commit 02c1e8f at 13:42 before s15 commit 6d0a744 at 13:45
report.md Left open: s39 hooks in s15 not wired

rule: After a wave's last merge, regenerate web/lib/api/openapi.json and schema.d.ts once from the integrated API and run pyright and tsc on the sprint branch before the next wave starts.
why: Per-branch gates passed, but the integrated branch needed a fix commit: stale generated client, and pyright errors at the s17/s15 seam fixed with casts.

rule: dev is protected in this repo: land the sprint branch through a PR into dev (merge commit), never a direct push or local merge into dev.
why: The run could not merge into dev and opened PR #47 instead.
evidence: report.md: dev is protected, so PR instead of merging to dev

rule: At INTAKE, check with ToolSearch whether Claude Design tools exist; if not, record the fallback in bmn.json assumptions up front and brief the designer for the shadcn/Tailwind fallback directly.
why: The designer found no Claude Design tools mid-run and fell back to a single shadcn/Tailwind direction with no previews.
evidence: design.md: Claude Design unavailable, ToolSearch +claude_design returned nothing
